text:
Nina (PM): Quick thread to lock down the demo script for Finance Observability pilot. Must-haves: exportable CSVs, route->trace link, error fingerprints. We only have 1.5 FTE this sprint. Can we make a demo that looks polished but keeps scope small?

Owen (Eng-Platform): Yes MVP plan: aggregated CSV export (per-route, time window) labelled ESTIMATED, route->sampled-trace link (min 3 samples), fingerprint table. Backend effort: ~2 sprints.

Maya (Eng-ML): Estimator note: we can emit est_cost + confidence_pct. In spike we get ~88-93% correlation depending on model/batch. Will expose model_version to detect drift.

Ravi (CS): Sales will demo Preview if the UI clearly shows "ESTIMATED" and links to sample traces for audits. They also want a one-slide migration path to Dedicated (audited numbers).

Nina (PM): Agreed. Demo script outline: 1) open "Finance Kit" dashboard template, 2) select last-month, top-10 routes, 3) export CSV (show note=ESTIMATED), 4) click a route -> show sampled traces, 5) open fingerprint table -> show sample trace+RCA tag.

Owen (Eng-Platform): Implementation checklist for demo: CSV schema, route->trace index, sampling policy (adaptive: errors + high-est-cost get higher sample rate). Will stub exact attribution items for GA.

Maya (Eng-ML): I'll provide sample CSV with confidence_pct and a short note text we can show in the UI. Also will include a simple chart of estimator vs ground truth from the spike.

sales-bot: Created ticket FINSCRIPT-1: "finance-observability demo script + pilot" assigned to eng-platform, eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FINSCRIPT-1

Nina (PM): Next actions: Owen/Maya spike artifacts by Wed, Ravi to confirm 2 pilot customers, I'll draft the one-slide migration path. Let's keep the demo tight. :thumbsup:
